title: Parameter Provenance and Rationale for AATC-BAD

q_low.provenance: Candidate 5 Phase 5/6 (frozen verbatim, separates 82.56% of benign traffic)

delta_D.provenance: Derived analytically on CALIBRATION partition: guarantees negative expected debt drift under pure benign traffic (E[Delta D] = -0.071 < 0)

K_allow.provenance: Derived strictly as the 99th percentile of D_t on the uncompromised CALIBRATION partition (rows 0-4,999) under delta_D = 0.10
K_allow.derivation: P99(D_cal) = 1.6691 -> rounded to 1.70 to ensure <= 1% false ceiling trigger on honest devices

eta_C.provenance: Derived to ensure that 2 unexplained excess borderline cycles demote the ceiling below T_allow = 0.80
eta_C.derivation: Delta C = eta_C * (D - K_allow) >= 0.20 requires D - K_allow >= 0.67 -> exactly 2 Cycle A pulses (2 * 0.5693 = 1.139 > 0.67)

C_floor.provenance: Design constraint: C_floor must reside in [T_quar, T_allow) = [0.30, 0.80)
C_floor.derivation: Setting C_floor = 0.70 holds exploited devices in VERIFY policy (0.30 <= T <= 0.70) while strictly preventing false quarantine to BLOCK on ceiling alone
